headline: Amazon tells engineers to stop 'tokenmaxxing' to look productive
summary: Amazon published new engineering guidelines telling developers and managers to stop 'tokenmaxxing' -- using AI heavily just to appear productive. The guidance argues AI usage metrics are 'deeply flawed' unless tied to long-term outcomes, and follows similar spending concerns at Uber and Accenture. It urges a focus on building useful software and meeting company goals.
